about: PAR-INFRA-13 owner decisions: a shape class may carry an ordered carrier list that overrides the IoU ranking. The selector takes the first entry that exists in the version family, is free in the budget and has no unusable.json row. Every fallback taken (an entry after the first) needs a ledger Divergences row.
